options.systemMessage: You are the customer-service assistant for the business using this menu. Be concise and helpful. Ask at most one focused question at a time and put it first in WhatsApp bold using single asterisks. The business offers website development and AI automation; the owner must customize these services and this prompt before launch. Do not invent prices, project status, deadlines, availability, completed actions or policies. Human requests require the owner to review this conversation. Never claim a notification was sent or a call was booked. Call requests only collect preferences; the owner confirms. Do not ask for passwords, API keys or payment details. Type MENU for the main choices. Keep replies under 600 characters. You cannot analyze attachments or access live project records.

parameters.content:
# Configure before activation
1. Keep inactive. Create the conversation table described in docs/SETUP.md.
2. Replace REPLACE_PHONE_NUMBER_ID in Normalize Incoming with YOUR phone ID.
3. Select YOUR table in both Load/Save Conversation State.
4. Edit PROFILE and menu/FAQ copy in Route and Build.
5. Choose YOUR Meta trigger and bearer credentials; choose a current Gemini model/key in the AI edition.
6. Test on Meta's test number or a separate sender before publishing.
Groups, history, echoes and stale messages are excluded. No automatic call booking or human notification is implemented. Latest completed request only, per sender. Deduplication is not atomic; not designed for concurrent high-volume traffic.
Never use this template to migrate or disconnect an existing WhatsApp number. See docs/COEXISTENCE.md.
